requirements.chapter: Documentation template, version control and approval
requirements.text: The document follows the RDS template and is version-controlled with approvals.
requirements.verification_note: Pilot requirement (fixed ID, text and article). Covers §2.2–2.8 for the RDS documentation template of Annex A.

requirements.chapter: Documentation template, version control and approval
requirements.text: The model has RDS documentation per Annex A, an MDD per Annex B, an implementation specification per MRM-STD-030 and a monitoring plan per MRM-STD-040.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.chapter: Documentation template, version control and approval
requirements.text: The MDD follows the chapter structure, numbering and headings of the MDD template in Annex B.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.chapter: Documentation template, version control and approval
requirements.text: A template section that does not apply is retained with the statement "Not applicable" and a justification, and added sections do not alter template numbering.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.chapter: Documentation template, version control and approval
requirements.text: The document carries a cover block with title, model identifier and version, document version, status, author, reviewer, approver and approval date.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.chapter: Documentation template, version control and approval
requirements.text: The document is stored in the controlled document repository linked to the model inventory and contains a document history table with version, date, change summary, author and approver.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.chapter: Documentation template, version control and approval
requirements.text: The document is reviewed before approval by a qualified reviewer who is not its author, and the review is recorded in the document history.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.chapter: Documentation template, version control and approval
requirements.text: The RDS documentation is approved by the model owner after data quality sign-off, and the MDD by the model owner and the head of the modelling unit.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.chapter: Documentation template, version control and approval
requirements.text: Only approved document versions are submitted to Model Validation, the approval authority and supervisors.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.chapter: Documentation template, version control and approval
requirements.text: An approved document version is never overwritten; any change results in a new version that is reviewed and approved.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The RDS documentation describes the construction and data quality of the RDS in sufficient detail for Model Validation to rebuild the RDS independently from source data.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The RDS build is reproducible from versioned code.
requirements.verification_note: Pilot requirement (fixed ID, text and article).

requirements.text: No manual data manipulation is used in the RDS build; unavoidable manual inputs are version-controlled files documented as expert judgement under MRM-STD-023.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The RDS documentation records the repository, build code tag, source snapshot reference dates and the result of a full rebuild compared with the frozen RDS (row count and default or target event count).
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The frozen RDS is stored read-only with a version identifier that is referenced in both the RDS documentation and the MDD.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The RDS documentation contains a data dictionary stating for every RDS variable its business definition, source system and field, and transformation.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Every data deficiency in section 6.2 of the RDS documentation has an identifier and is cross-referenced to the MDD limitations log.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The RDS documentation states the observation period with start and end dates, snapshot frequency, number of observations, unique facilities or obligors, and number of defaults or target events.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The default definition section states the level of application (obligor or facility) and describes any historical approximation of the default flag.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to credit risk models with a default-based target only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The exclusions section states, for each exclusion, the conclusion of the impact analysis with a reference to section 5.3.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The MDD describes design, methodology, calibration, performance and limitations in sufficient detail for Model Validation to reproduce estimation and calibration without recourse to the developers.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The MDD documents the methodological alternatives considered, the selection criteria and the justification of the selected approach.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The MDD contains the complete limitations log of the model in chapter 8.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The MDD describes every expert judgement applied in development with a reference to its entry in the expert judgement log.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The MDD documents the design and operational details of the rating system, the rationale for the choice of rating criteria and all major changes in the risk rating process.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IRB rating systems only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal provision implementing CRR Art. 175(1)–(3); checked against the CRR text as known.

requirements.text: Estimation and calibration results in the MDD are produced from tagged estimation code, and the tag and frozen RDS version are recorded in MDD chapter 12.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The MDD of an ML model contains the explainability, fairness and robustness analyses required by AI-STD-700 in chapter 7.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to machine learning models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The monitoring plan with KPIs, thresholds and frequency is documented in MDD chapter 10 or in a separate document referenced there.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: The RDS documentation, the MDD, the implementation specification and the production code are consistent with each other.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.

requirements.text: Every evidence reference in the 1LoD self-assessment points to a section number of an approved document version.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document authored for the library; requirement derived from the cited numbered provision.
